_comment: Seed poses for lab_console.py (loaded before the per-session pose file).
Joint angles in radians, base frame. `ready` was derived on the real arm
2026-09-30: tool pointing straight down at about (-0.22, +0.13, +0.50) m
in base_link, wrist centre well off the shoulder axis, so 5 cm Cartesian
moves in all six directions plan to 100% (the cold folded resting pose
cannot go left/right at all - the wrist sits on the shoulder singularity).
shoulder_pan and wrist_3 are left where the session started so a go_to
never spins the base or the tool. Reaching `ready` from the folded pose is
a ~1.9 rad wrist_1 swing: needs --max-excursion 2.0, a low pendant slider
`front` (2026-10-02) is `ready` with the base turned -90 degrees: the same
top-down posture, but over the front of the stand where the ZED looks
and the pick area is. It is the hub the pick workflow starts from.
